title: run_state.json — current run state (TECH_SPEC §3.5, D8a/NFR-08; ADR-008 stage vocabulary)
description: One per run; replaceable (last-write-wins). Makes resume explicit: a session reads this + the existing artifacts and continues from current_stage without redoing `done` stages (§9). Stages are the ADR-008 pipeline (ingest → si_v1 → enrichment → si_v2 → jira); the BRD/FRD-era names are retired and rejected. Records run progress only — never artifact content (FR-XS-05).

stage.description: Kept identical to telemetry.schema.json's stage vocabulary — the two ledgers must never drift (telemetry.mark_stage advances both in lock-step).
